courses.title: ToolTest 2 - Offset Face
courses.objective: Offset selected faces and verify neighboring topology heals around the edited faces.

steps.title: Create reference solid
steps.instructions: Create a stepped solid with neighboring faces around the target face.
steps.expectedResult: A valid solid with a clear target face.

checkpoint.expected: A valid solid with a clear target face.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Offset face outward
steps.instructions: Select one face and offset it outward.
steps.expectedResult: The selected face moves outward while neighboring geometry reconnects.

checkpoint.expected: The selected face moves outward while neighboring geometry reconnects.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Offset face inward
steps.instructions: Edit the offset to a negative value.
steps.expectedResult: The selected face moves inward and the body heals.

checkpoint.expected: The selected face moves inward and the body heals.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.
